Name: Flight Control
Description: An air-traffic puzzle: draw each aircraft's landing path and never let two of them meet.

Achievements.Name: Air Wolf
Achievements.Description: Land more than 10 helicopters in a single game.

Achievements.Name: Catastrophic Failure
Achievements.Description: Have 3 separate collisions occur at the same time.

Achievements.Name: Crikey
Achievements.Description: Land over 100 planes on a single map.

Achievements.Name: Danger Zone
Achievements.Description: Have more than 15 planes on screen at once.

Achievements.Name: Get Around
Achievements.Description: Play on each map at least once.

Achievements.Name: Holding Pattern
Achievements.Description: After landing the first plane, keep the same plane on screen for more than 5 minutes.

Achievements.Name: Impatience is a Virtue
Achievements.Description: Land more than 10 jets in a single game.

Achievements.Name: Medic!
Achievements.Description: Have 5 emergency planes land in a single game.

Achievements.Name: No Fly Zone
Achievements.Description: After landing the first plane, land no planes for two minutes.

Achievements.Name: No Pressure
Achievements.Description: Play for more than 10 minutes in a single round.

Achievements.Name: Top-Gun
Achievements.Description: Land over 50 planes on the Aircraft Carrier.

Achievements.Name: Fundamentals
Achievements.Description: Land a cumulative total of 10 planes.

Achievements.Name: Centurion
Achievements.Description: Land a cumulative total of 100 planes.

Achievements.Name: Millenial Man
Achievements.Description: Land a cumulative total of 1000 planes.

Achievements.Name: Over Nine Thousand!
Achievements.Description: Land a cumulative total of 10,000 planes.
